_comment: Submission manifest for the row-6 decision-rung stage (issue #244 AC 4c).
The batch-set wrote each request's output under evidence-r6-ladder/request-*/;
the four directories were then renamed to the flat layout the assembler reads
same bytes, only the directory names changed. This manifest records the rename.
Attempt history: the four requests were first submitted individually ~40 min
c79b7f0e77f1); the shared fleet was over its vCPU budget (288 running against
BATCH_MAX_VCPU=224, quota shared with ci-spot), those submitters exhausted
their capacity wait and exited with the jobs never provisioned, so the stage
was resubmitted as this --batch-set with --capacity-retries 30 and all four
members ran on the first capacity that opened. The dead attempt-1 job ids are
recorded here and are never cited as evidence.
